claims.text: Creating a hierarchical microstructure with lubricant-rich phases and a strong, high-temperature-resistant backbone will improve tribological performance across a wide temperature range.
The proposed material is at an initial development stage.
The proposed intervention is to design a hierarchical microstructure containing lubricant-rich phases and a strong, high-temperature-resistant backbone.
The material is intended to operate over a wide temperature range under extreme mechanical-system conditions.
The hierarchical microstructure balances mechanical strength and lubrication efficiency.
Balancing mechanical strength and lubrication efficiency leads to stable tribological performance.
The proposed microstructure will enhance mechanical strength.
The proposed microstructure will enhance lubrication efficiency.
Previous materials or designs failed to balance mechanical strength and lubrication efficiency.
A comparison against materials without the hierarchical microstructure can test the hypothesis using friction coefficient, wear rate, tensile strength, and hardness.
